Market forecasts, European strengths, Collins Aerospace What caught our eye this last week? There’s differing views on semiconductor forecasts, European strengths in the chip industry, and Collins Aerospace opening its UK Engineering Centre of Excellence… The Electronics Weekly team share some fingerposts – their picks of the week, in terms of announcements, developments, product releases, quotes, or anything else in the wide world of electronics, that caught their eye… Caroline Hayes, editor I liked Bullish Yole semi forecast at odds with Future Horizons – the kind of story AI can’t write! Some optimism on the semiconductor market but different theories for how we got there. David Manners, components editor European efforts to help the chip industry have not gone well so why don’t they mobilise European strengths ? Alun Williams, web editor What caught my eye was Collins Aerospace opening its UK Engineering Centre of Excellence in Wolverhampton. It will expand the company’s aircraft electrification capabilities, specifically for its electric thrust reverser actuation systems, elecTRAS.
